The validation record shipped with bdhs

Source: R/validate.R
bdhs_validation_record.Rd

Every indicator in bdhs_indicator_list() that has an official DHS value was checked by computing it with bdhs_validate() from the maintainer's own copies of the BDHS recode files and comparing it with the DHS Program API value. This function returns that record: national aggregates only, no microdata.

Usage

bdhs_validation_record()

Value

A tibble with columns survey_id, recode, indicator, computed, official and pass.

Details

An indicator-round passes when the computed value is within 0.5 points (plus half a unit of the official value's rounding) of the official value. Rounds and recodes not in the record have not been checked, usually because the maintainer had no copy of that file.

See also

bdhs_validate() to check your own copy of the data.

Examples

rec <- bdhs_validation_record()
table(rec$survey_id, rec$pass)
#>            
#>             FALSE TRUE
#>   BD1994DHS     0   24
#>   BD2000DHS     0   27
#>   BD2004DHS     0   26
#>   BD2007DHS     0   28
#>   BD2011DHS     0   27
#>   BD2014DHS     0   28
#>   BD2017DHS     0  104
#>   BD2022DHS     2   89
